The Antonio Circosta Law Firm provides expert advice in Ecclesiastical Law, supporting religious institutions, foundations, associations and individuals in all matters where faith and law intersect.

Areas of Assistance

  • Legal recognition of religious bodies.
  • Agreements with public authorities.
  • Governance of ecclesiastical entities.
  • Property and tax issues connected to religious organisations, ensuring that their activities are carried out in compliance with both civil and ecclesiastical regulations.

Cross-Border Matters

With our international expertise, we also assist in cross-border matters involving churches, charities and cultural institutions, where multiple legal systems must coexist.

We are committed to safeguarding the balance between religious freedom and the requirements of civil law, ensuring that institutions and individuals receive tailored, reliable legal protection.
